capabilities: Upload local attachments from the current note to public or private S3 buckets
Replace local links with public HTTPS/CDN links or private s3-bridge:// references
Preview private S3 files inside Obsidian after SSO authentication
Authenticate with IAM Identity Center (SSO) temporary credentials
Archive uploaded originals to _s3-archive and restore them later
disambiguation: Does not sync the vault to S3; it only uploads note attachments and stores references, leaving notes themselves local.
extras: Preview release 0.1.3; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Detailed specifications live in docs/ rather than the README. Desktop only (tested on macOS, Obsidian 1.14.5); S3-compatible storage and static credentials are unsupported in this preview.
problem: Obsidian keeps attachments as local vault files and has no built-in way to offload them to cloud storage or preview private cloud-hosted files inside notes.

relations.evidence: Manage Obsidian attachments on AWS S3.

requires.name: AWS account with IAM Identity Center (SSO) profile and bucket permissions
AWS storage, requests, data transfer and delivery charges

summary: Attachment manager that uploads note attachments to AWS S3, replaces links with public URLs or private s3-bridge references, and previews private files.
